entities.summary: Lorella Zanardo is an Italian business consultant, film maker, author and women's rights activist. After a career working for Unilever and Arnoldo Mondadori Editore, she released the documentary Il corpo delle donne in 2009. She followed it with a book of the same name and another book entitled Senza chiedere il permesso: Come cambiamo la tv . Zanardo stood as a candidate for The Other Europe in the 2014 European Parliament election.
